A '''pilot''' [[Pilot/Legends|flew]] an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] as '''Polearm Leader''' of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Polearm Squadron/Legends|Polearm Squadron]]. During the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], Polearm Leader participated in the [[Battle for the Razor's Kiss|battle for the ''Razor's Kiss'']].<ref name="if" />
